exercises.instruction: MARK THE DIRECTIONS THAT LEAD YOU TO THE CORRECT PLACES

items.question: Go straight ahead. The swimming pool is opposite the castle. / Go straight ahead. The swimming pool is opposite the station.
options: Go straight ahead. The swimming pool is opposite the castle.
Go straight ahead. The swimming pool is opposite the station.
items.correct_answer: Go straight ahead. The swimming pool is opposite the station.

items.question: Take the second left. The school is opposite the factory. / Take the third left. The school is next to the factory.
options: Take the second left. The school is opposite the factory.
Take the third left. The school is next to the factory.
items.correct_answer: Take the second left. The school is opposite the factory.

items.question: Turn right and take the second right. The church is opposite the hotel. / Turn right and take the first left. The church is opposite the hotel.
options: Turn right and take the second right. The church is opposite the hotel.
Turn right and take the first left. The church is opposite the hotel.
items.correct_answer: Turn right and take the second right. The church is opposite the hotel.

items.question: Take the third left and go straight ahead. The theater is on the right. / Take the third right and go straight ahead. The theater is on the left.
options: Take the third left and go straight ahead. The theater is on the right.
Take the third right and go straight ahead. The theater is on the left.
items.correct_answer: Take the third left and go straight ahead. The theater is on the right.
